extension.name: express-transaction-monitor
extension.title: Express: Real-Time Transaction Monitor
extension.description: Stream live data to the browser as it happens with an Express app using Server-Sent Events. It monitors a simulated feed of bank card transactions, flagging suspicious ones and updating running totals (volume, transaction count, and flagged rate) in real time with no page refresh. A starting point for any live feed; point the stream at your own source, like a message queue, a database change feed, or a webhook.
